dataList.content:
An overlong silence shrouded the passage of time.
长久的沉默将岁月掩盖。

All my time during it was a mere adjunct.
迄今为止，我的时间不过仅是附属。

In the square wholly painted white, only two visitors came to see me.
在这四面被漆成纯白的四方形中，唯有两位访客。

To supplement... One visited in the square within the square, and the other visited in the square within the square within the square.
顺便一提……一位是四方形内的四方形的访客，而另一位是四方形内的四方形内的四方形的访客。

N Corp. Cubic Room
N公司的四方形房间

dataList.content:
You're free to do your research here.
你就在这尽情研究吧。

dataList.content:
The mirror you seemed to love so dearly.
你如此钟爱的镜子技术。

dataList.title:
N Corp.
N公司
dataList.content:
Don't forget to eat your meals and supplements every day.
别忘了每天摄取食物和营养剂。

There was no one left to gaze at the mirror and enjoy its sight, and it ceased to be a tool of amusement...
再也没有面对镜子而感欣喜之人了，这也不再是消遣了……

Yet I still held on to it, for a reason...
即便如此，我仍放不下镜子的理由是……

dataList.title:
Yeonsim
研心
dataList.content:
You wouldn't talk to even Gubo these days. You've been grasping at the mirror all day long.
你最近就算是和仇甫也不说话了。一整天都抓着镜子不放。

dataList.title:
Yeonsim
研心
dataList.content:
He just stared at your back before leaving. The expression on his face wasn't so good.
他也只是默默看着你的背影便离开了。表情不怎么高兴。

It concerns me not. I would much rather face you and talk to you.
无所谓。我更愿与你面对面交谈。

When I turn away, I would like you to do the same.
即使我背向你，你也不会背过身去。

dataList.title:
Yeonsim
研心
dataList.content:
Yi Sang, Gubo genuinely cares about you. You know that, right?
李箱，仇甫是从心底重视着你的。你明白吗？

dataList.title:
Yeonsim
研心
dataList.content:
I'm pretty sure you're the biggest reason he decided to join the League before it fell apart.
仇甫虽然是最后加入九人会的，我却觉得他受你影响最大。

That is untrue. The one Gubo cares for the most... would be himself.
并非如此。仇甫最珍惜的人……是他自己。

He simply happened to chance upon me while looking for things to make him stand out.
只是他在寻找能让自己出人头地的事物时，我恰好映入了他的眼帘。

dataList.title:
Yeonsim
研心
dataList.content:
Then... let him do that. You can be under the limelight as long as you're standing next to him.
那……就让他如此去做吧。只要站在他身侧，你也能闪闪发光。

dataList.title:
Yeonsim
研心
dataList.content:
Right now, N Corp's director has been trying to form a new League of Nine with you, Gubo, and Aseah.
听说N公司的董事正要带领你、仇甫和亚细亚组建新的九人会。

I cannot bring myself to call that organization the League when its roots are entirely different. It has simply borrowed the name that will have to be returned one day.
这种从根源上改变了的集体，我无法称之为九人会。只是借了名字，总有一日要归还吧。

...How go the affairs in the world outside? With your wings, you can be anywhere you'd like.
……外面的世界如何？你生有翅膀，想去哪里都可以吧。

dataList.title:
Yeonsim
研心
dataList.content:
The outside... Haah. It's the same, tiring stuff. The world always flows along the same current.
外界……哈。每次都是一样，令人疲倦。世界总是向着同一个流向流动。

dataList.title:
Yeonsim
研心
dataList.content:
Isn't that the truth? The League used to be bound with such strong solidarity, but now it has disbanded...
难道不是这样吗？有着如此深厚关系的九人也会分崩离析……

dataList.title:
Yeonsim
研心
dataList.content:
There's no point in feeling joy or despair over every passing moment.
每时每刻都欢欣鼓舞或万念俱灰没有意义。

dataList.title:
Yeonsim
研心
dataList.content:
So I want you to stay here with me. Be someone I can talk with.
所以我想让你与我一同留在这里。做我的交谈对象。
